item.title: Version 1.1.0
item.description: New main window layout. Sessions in the sidebar are grouped into Needs you, Working and Idle, with a History section; Settings moved to the toolbar. Live panels have their own Watching page, and Today shows up to two running panels. Today shows the top decision as a full card with collapsible details, the other decisions as one-line rows, and context beside them. A session thread shows how each decision ended in one line. The Island card can expand the full message.
